author: Kusha N M
raw:
ತಪ್ಪಿಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೇ ತಲೆಯೆತ್ತಿ ನಡೆಯುತಿರು
ಸೊಪ್ಪಹಾಕದಿರೆಂದು ದಾರಿತಪ್ಪಿಸೊ ಜನಕೆ
ತಪ್ಪನೊಪ್ಪುತ ತಿದ್ದೆ ಜೀವನವೆ ಸುಂದರವು
ತಪ್ಪಿನಡೆಯದಿರು ನೀ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: If you have done no wrong, walk with your head held high;
don’t let people lead you astray by feeding you flattery;
life is beautiful when you own your mistakes and correct them;
so do not stray from the right path, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: A clear conscience lets us walk tall. Do not be misled by others, admit and correct our own mistakes, and life becomes beautiful.
